Customer (Sarah Grant): How long will that take?
Agent (Kagiso Radebe): You'll get a call with the outcome within five business days.
Agent (Kagiso Radebe): To recap: the regulated charges stand, a billing specialist is checking each line, and you'll hear back within five business days.
Customer (Sarah Grant): Alright, thank you for looking into it.
Agent (Kagiso Radebe): Thanks for bearing with me — you're all set.

Agent (Sipho van der Merwe): To recap: your self-read is on file, the next bill corrects the estimate, and the reader will call ahead about the gate.

Customer (Brian Baker): I'm following up again — I've just been hit with a CA$1,800 bill after hearing nothing from you for most of a year.

Customer (Brian Baker): So I still owe all of it?
Agent (Karabo Zulu): The balance matches the metered usage, so yes. It doesn't have to be paid at once, though.
Agent (Karabo Zulu): To recap: the balance stands, a payment plan is available whenever you want it, and the billing team is reviewing how the account was missed.
